title: Music Competition
subtitle: 音乐比赛通知 · 据 2025 年第一次考试（3-4 场）回忆要点改编
body: Good morning, everyone. This is Li Hua from the Student Union. Our school is going to hold a music competition this term, and we hope you can join us. The competition is open to all junior high students, so it doesn't matter which grade you are in. You can sing a song or play an instrument, on your own or with your friends. If you want to take part, please record a video of your performance and send it to Ms. Wang, our music teacher, before next Friday. Remember, each video should be no longer than five minutes. The final will be held in the school hall on December twentieth. The winners will get tickets to the New Year Concert. It's a great chance to show your talent and enjoy music together. Don't miss it!

title: A Visit to the City Zoo
subtitle: 参观城市动物园 · 据 2025 年第二次考试回忆要点改编
body: Hello, everyone. I have some good news for you. Next Monday, our class is going to visit the City Zoo. We will meet at the school gate at eight o'clock in the morning and go there by school bus. At the zoo, we will see pandas, elephants and many other animals. A zoo worker will also tell us how to take care of them. Before we go, I'd like to remind you of some rules. First, please don't make loud noises, because that may frighten the animals. Second, never feed the animals with your own food. It may make them sick. It's going to be sunny and hot that day, so remember to bring enough water and a sun hat. We will come back to school at about three in the afternoon. I hope you will have a wonderful time!

title: Welcoming Party for New Students
subtitle: 新生欢迎派对 · 根据文档模拟范文配套编写
body: Good afternoon, new students! Welcome to our school. To help you get to know each other, the Student Union is going to hold a welcoming party for you. The party will be held in the school main hall. It will begin at half past six next Monday evening and last about two hours. All the teachers, as well as students from different grades, are going to attend it. During the party, we will sing songs, play games and give speeches. Some older students will also share their stories about school life. To get ready for it, please wear your school uniforms and bring a small gift. We'll exchange the gifts at the end of the party. It will be a great chance to make new friends. We're looking forward to seeing you there!

title: A Field Trip to the Farm
subtitle: 实地考察 · 据 2025 年第一次考试（1-2 场）话题原创
body: Hi, everyone. Next Wednesday, Grade Eight will go on a field trip to Green Valley Farm. We'll take the bus at the school gate at seven thirty in the morning, and it takes about one hour to get there. In the morning, you'll learn how to plant vegetables, and you can also pick fresh strawberries. In the afternoon, a farmer will show us how to make cheese. Please wear comfortable shoes, because we will walk a lot. Lunch will be provided on the farm, but you'd better bring a bottle of water. After the trip, each of you should write a short report about what you have learned and hand it in by next Friday. The best reports will be shown on the school website. I'm sure you'll learn a lot and have fun.

title: A Special Family Moment
subtitle: 家庭时刻 · 据 2025 年第二次考试话题原创（练习人称转换）
body: Hi, I'm Tom. I'd like to tell you about a special family moment. Last Sunday was my grandma's seventieth birthday. My parents and I decided to prepare a surprise for her. First, I made a birthday card with old photos of our family. Then my dad and I cooked her favourite dishes, noodles and fish. It was my first time to cook, and I almost burnt the fish! In the evening, the whole family sat together and sang Happy Birthday to her. When Grandma read the card, she smiled with tears in her eyes. She said it was the best present she had ever got. From this experience, I learned that love is not about expensive gifts. Spending time with family is the most important thing.
